notes: A202272_main (A202272_mathlib.lean): n is a term iff it has at most one nonzero digit, or its nonzero digits are one 1 and one 9 with the block 10 present; this is exactly k*10^j, 10X, 9Y10Z. Proof: a partial sum in [10,18] forces a 1; two 1s force all digits and then a count of blocks by leading digit makes the digit sum exceed every power of 10 (no_two_ones); one 1 excludes 2..8 via the sums 17, 15, 11 and a second 9 via 18. Outside Lean: none. Not verified in Lean: the translation of the characterization into the three written forms (reading). Brute force n < 10^7 agrees.
